subject: Pilot Ramp Proposal — tiered token commits & milestone discounts (Brightline)
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@brightline.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 10:15:00 -0800
Subject: Initial MAP & ramp proposal for pilot

Alex — great to meet you on Thursday. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and SOW draft for the pilot. High-level ask: confirm whether Brightline can commit to a 3-stage ramp over the evaluation window so we can price the pilot with milestone-based discounts.

Proposed commercial structure (pilot -> production):
- Pilot length: 30 days (evaluation) — objective: validate accuracy on two key workflows (prior auth, patient triage)
- Stage 1 (Month 1 post-pilot): 10M tokens/month (TPM) — exploratory production
- Stage 2 (Months 2–3): 25M TPM — steady utilization
- Stage 3 (Months 4–6): 50M TPM — production scale with autoscale threshold

Pricing / discounts tied to achieved monthly TPM:
- < 20M TPM: standard hosted rate (no volume discount)
- 20–40M TPM: 10% volume discount applied to token rate the following month
- >= 40M TPM: 18% discount + 2% committed billing credit when month-end usage >= target

Mutual actions I propose in the MAP (first 45 days):
- Brightline: provide 3 production prompt templates + dataset access for evaluation (due by day 7)
- Redwood: deploy pilot on dedicated instance, baseline latency & cost report (day 14)
- Joint: weekly syncs, final evaluation verdict (day 30), and go/no-go decision + signature of SOW if committing to Stage 1

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_v3.xlsx, SOW-draft-redwood-2026.pdf

If that ramp cadence looks reasonable, I can circulate a tracked SOW with the tiered commit language and an appendix that defines how we measure TPM and invoicing cadence. Would love your quick take so we can align contract and procurement timelines.

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
